capability: Measure the motion before anyone sees it
title: Put a ring on every turn.

hook.picture: Close on the whale making a sharp turn; the camera whips with it.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The animation made people feel a bit sick.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: viewer comment under a course video

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: speed is judged by eye on a small preview; each turn is sharper than it looks. Three-times device: the whale whips round three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, each turn sharper.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Our eyes miss how fast it moves.

stakes.body: Viewers drop off, and some cannot watch at all, so the lesson never lands.

solution_hint: Measure each turn before anyone sees it.

metaphor.body: A ring rides with the whale and measures each turn. A turn that overfills the ring stops the film before it is made.

steps.picture: A ring follows the whale; on each turn it measures how far the whale swung in one step.
steps.words: Measure each turn before anyone sees it.

steps.picture: A sharp turn fills the ring past its mark; the ring glows copper and the film stops before it is made.
The whale makes the same turn spread over more steps; the ring stays inside its mark and glows teal.
steps.words: Same turn, slower. Now it passes.

steps.picture: A gate stands at the end of the line; only measured runs pass it; its name appears.
steps.words: Every run measured at the door: gate.

real_case.claim: Whale Line, The brief v1: gates caught the whale's take-off turning at 1.26 rad/frame against a 0.35 limit (fixed to 0.11) and its swim at 41 px/frame (fixed to 26.5), before render. The numbers stay in NOTES.

honest_limit.picture: Push in: a perfectly smooth, slow film passes every gate, and the pod yawns, its eyes drifting.
honest_limit.words: Smooth and safe can still be dull.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing returns. The whale makes the same turn as bar 1, now eased, with the ring inside its mark; the camera stays steady; the pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The turn that whipped the camera in bar 1 is made again in the same framing, smooth.

end_belief.body: Let a machine measure what eyes miss.

score_self.reason: Self-referential and honest: the studio's own gate caught its own whale. The pain is physical and clear. Weak: "Beauty is not a gate." names gate as a term again in LIMIT.
